items.question: What attitude and offerings are required for worship in the month of Āśvina?
premises: The month of Āśvina is designated as the time for worship.
Worship must be performed with devotion.
Eatables and foods must be offered in great abundance.
items.inference: In the month of Āśvina, one should perform worship with devotion and abundant offerings of eatables and foods.
uncertainties: The deity to be worshipped is not explicitly named in this verse and may be carried over from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: In the month of Āśvina, one should worship with devotion, offering eatables and foods in great abundance.
